svg.title: Monte Carlo paths through what you might have meant
svg.desc: Many random paths leave one sentence and end in three bundles, one for each thing the person might have meant. The readers are spread apart on purpose so the bundles get found, and a person picks one.
svg.text: You say: capitalize the customer's name
Illustration: each line is one possible meaning of the sentence.
The readers spread out so every bundle gets found, then a person picks one.
